elements.element: The obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added paragraph applies upon expiration or termination of the Agreement or any Service Option Attachment.

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance without an additional condition.
elements.evidence: IBM's duty is conditioned on Customer making a request; the preferred position does not state this condition.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for up to 6 months.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly provides assistance for up to six months.

elements.element: Transition assistance is provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause specifies IBM's then-current rates.

elements.element: The covered data is all Customer Data.
elements.evidence: The clause covers capitalized “Content,” and the supplied language does not establish that this term includes all Customer Data.

elements.element: Vendor returns the covered data to Customer.
elements.evidence: IBM must return all covered Content to Customer.

elements.element: The data return occurs within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The return is expressly required within 30 days after expiration or termination.

elements.element: The data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: A “commonly used, machine-readable format” satisfies the required standard machine-readable format.

elements.element: Vendor deletes the returned data after return.
elements.evidence: IBM must delete all returned Content from its systems after the return.

elements.element: Vendor certifies the deletion to Customer.
elements.evidence: IBM must certify the deletion to Customer in writing.

elements.element: The obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added paragraph applies upon expiration or termination of the Agreement or any Service Option Attachment.

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance without an additional condition.
elements.evidence: The assistance duty applies only at Customer's request, an additional condition not stated in the fallback.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: An assistance period of up to six months encompasses the fallback 90-day period.

elements.element: The covered data is Customer Data.
elements.evidence: The export obligation applies to “Content,” without operative language establishing that Content includes all Customer Data.

elements.element: Vendor exports the covered data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Returning all covered Content in a commonly used, machine-readable format is an export to Customer.

elements.element: The data export occurs within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause requires the return within 30 days after expiration or termination.

result.reason: Neither level is completely satisfied. Transition assistance is newly conditioned on a Customer request, and the operative data obligations cover “Content” rather than demonstrably covering all Customer Data. The drafting is also overbroad: termination of any single Service Option Attachment triggers return and deletion of all Content, potentially impairing services continuing under other attachments. Because no complete level is reached and this broader trigger may affect unrelated continuing services, the redline is neither minimal nor fully intent-preserving.
